name: VolunTEEN Program
what_you_do: A summer program where high school students help patients, families and staff and learn about health careers. It is hard to get in.
who_can_apply: High school students. Offered only at UF Health Gainesville. Both the teen and one parent must attend an info session. Ages are not stated on the page.
duration: About 6 weeks in summer (June 21 to Aug 5)
deadline_text: The page title says Summer 2026, but the dates read like 2027 (application Jan 4 to Jan 22, interviews April 6 to 8, orientation Friday June 18, program June 21 to Aug 5, 2027). Treat dates as unconfirmed.
how_to_apply: Apply online in January. Then go to an info session, fill out an interest form and join a group interview.
notes: The page mixes 2026 and 2027, so check it in December. Jacksonville students: UF Health Jacksonville has its own program.
